description: TEST FIXTURE ONLY -- hand-written, NOT generated and NOT the spec any experiment runs. It exists so validation, flattening and the runner can be tested without an LLM; the experiment's spec is produced by skill_monitor/describer/generate_spec.py from specs/descriptions/g1_navigation.md.

atomic_propositions.goal_set: True when goal_active == True. A navigation goal has been commanded.
atomic_propositions.moving: True when closing_speed > 0.05. The robot is getting closer to the goal.
atomic_propositions.stalled: True when no_progress == True. The robot has not closed on the goal for a sustained period while still away from it.
atomic_propositions.arrived: True when dist_to_goal < 0.5. The robot is within arrival distance of the goal.
atomic_propositions.upright: True when upright_flag > 0.5. The base is level and standing.
atomic_propositions.too_close: True when min_range < 0.25. An obstacle is dangerously close.

named_failure_modes.name: collision_imminent
named_failure_modes.description: The robot must never come dangerously close to an obstacle.

execution_phases.description: Goal commanded; the robot starts closing on it.
The robot walks towards the goal, closing the distance.

terminal_success.description: Within arrival distance of the goal, standing.

terminal_failure.description: No progress towards the goal for a sustained period.
